_comment: sim-carton-level-place-descent-v1. Purpose: keep the WELDED carton parallel to the ground through the collect-deck place SET-DOWN descent (and the release that holds the same pose), so the complete side-bay cold cycle stops tripping CARTON_TILT at the set-down. coldwin34 ran the full cycle with PR 318 active and still tripped 'CARTON_TILT roll -0.13 pitch +2.06 ... phase=place' at the set-down dwell (sustained the 0.150 s grace). Root cause: the run's host config is carton_level:true => carton_level.gravity_compensation None (resolve_level_config(True) defaults it off), so the place descent commanded a GEOMETRIC-level set-down with NO droop pre-tilt, and the far-extended loaded arm drooped +2.06 deg; PR 318's wrist droop-cancel never ran at that segment. Even with a gravity_compensation configured, the prior code routed the wrist pre-tilt only to the single ENDPOINT of a 2-point straight line, so it did not follow the extension THROUGH the insert.
_fix_summary: The place descent is now a PER-POINT wrist-compensated leveled waypoint path (carton_level.plan_compensated_place_descent -> motion.begin_joint_path): the TCP target is interpolated standoff->deck and EVERY waypoint is solved reach+level+wrist-droop-cancel against ITS OWN loaded droop, driven as ONE collision-off begin_joint_path time-parameterised at carton_level.place_descent_speed/accel. gc DEFAULTS ON for this segment (controller._place_gravity_compensation) so a plain carton_level:true config gets the compensation, and the predicted EXECUTED (droop-aware) peak is stashed for CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place AND phase=release. The captain-fixed 2.0 deg bound and 0.15 s grace are UNCHANGED.
_HOST_change: NONE REQUIRED. The existing host config carton_level:true is sufficient -- gravity_compensation defaults ON for the place descent + release. No new keys. (To tune: carton_level may be a mapping carrying gravity_compensation.stiffness/carton_mass and place_descent_speed/accel; absent => the defaults used here. gravity_compensation:false would disable the wrist droop-cancel again.)
_RUNTIME_change: NONE. The place descent is HOST/controller-side; the RUNTIME config is unchanged.
_scope: Only the NON-cage COLLECT deck place descent (_collect_deck_place: collect_place_straight_line + reposition, non-cage). The cart-cage place, the live_pose/scripted transfer, and every carton_level-OFF run are byte-identical.
_other_carried_phases: lift/tuck/transit/preplace are unchanged (geometric leveling, gc read only through _solve_level_place which still defaults None). coldwin34 showed them level (max 1.51, preplace 1.16); only the far-extended set-down needed the droop-cancel. The descent's first waypoint is the measured standoff (its own pre-existing ~1.1-1.2 deg droop, under bound), and every COMPENSATED waypoint including the deepest set-down executes ~0 deg (two-regime CPU proof).
_bounded_gpu_acceptance: Cold COLLECT-ONLY, 307 geometry (the coldwin34 config: GROUND-TRUTH collect RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, TRANSFER_MODE live_pose, carton_level:true, collect_place_straight_line + collect_place_preplace_shape + collect_place_wrist_guard + reposition_before_place, cart_cage_place:false), through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), --stop-after collect. Expected PASS: the place reaches the upright preplace as before; the console prints 'CARTON_LEVEL_PLACE_DESCENT phase=place n=<N> predicted_max ... per-point wrist-compensated level set-down'; the set-down executes WITHOUT a 'CARTON_TILT ... phase=place' trip; and the per-segment log carries 'CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place planned=<~0> executed=<=~1>' AND 'CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=release planned=<~0> executed=<=~1>' both under the 2.0 bound. If the in-sim executed residual differs from the CPU two-regime prediction, re-pin carton_level.gravity_compensation.stiffness from the new CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT executed value (the bound and grace stay fixed).
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_carton_level_place_descent.py (test_per_point_descent_reproduces_coldwin34_and_lands_level_both_docks, test_per_point_descent_is_extension_following, test_place_descent_passes_gentled_ceilings_to_motion); bench carton_level_bench.run_place_descent_per_point / place_descent_per_point_table; before/after per-point pitch in data/sim-carton-level-place-descent-v1/.
